facts.fact: 光牢：Aurora Tower 被抹后 Ulshära 掷黏土球（恶臭烟）放倒俘虏——Dante 醒于 imperator 塔顶：无窗石墙、灼肤光膜门、lightsbane+皮革口枷、Lumin crystals 连续光波——「The others do not have such restraints」（Shade 血统专属克制）。
facts.anchor: Dante had once gone mad with darkness.

facts.fact: 精神自稳：他把晶体光想象成 Vaegan 海岸阳光、把 Nikolas 踱步听成潮汐；Camilla「Vanished. Not crushed under sandstone but freed」——她走了，他还在。
facts.anchor: She got to walk free and he—

facts.fact: 囚友点名：Angelica 以三种语言试探卫兵（Solari 回骂）；Fin「Not this again」；Rian 的 cuff 摘不下但 lightsbane 妨碍连接；Risha 哑声报「They have Thana’s fulcrum」「Part of it」。
facts.anchor: “Are you overgrown fireflies fluent in Vaegan?”

facts.fact: 情报摊牌：Nikolas 吞吞吐吐供出「I—We think it might have some of… his fulcrum in it」；Julian 补 Starfell 定位 Nyx 碎片的先例——「The spear might be able to do the same」。
塔上审讯：Ulshära 亲至（肩羽为 graft 非纹身）；解枷后 Dante 强制失败（无魔音只在嗓）——「Perhaps you are used to giving the orders where you are from. But here, we do not bow to the children of lesser gods.」
facts.anchor: we do not bow to the children of lesser gods.

facts.fact: 政治交锋：Nyx 的 Solarian 称呼=Starscourge；Dante 反问 Astrum 近袭（Ulshära 露出困惑）——「The Child of the Starscourge...killed my god-brother and destroyed his tower. We know she is your kin」——Taesia 顶罪；他自嘲公平（幼时兄长代妹受罚，如今反向）。
烙刑：水晶烙小臂与肋（white hot 的「细 punctuation」）——「What are her plans?」——「She came here on her own. She’s working independently from us. I don't know what she's planning.」（半谎半真：目标大抵相同）。
解围与带走：Nikolas 以蹩脚 Solari 喊话——Ulshära 惊讶回话收起水晶——「your presence here is unwelcome」（言外：but you can be helpful）——「You two are a different matter. You will come with me.」（Nikolas+Rian 被单独带走）。
facts.anchor: “You two,” she said, “are a different matter.
